test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following States/Union Territories were the 36th National Games held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Games:-**

 
 
• The National Games is a** biennial multi-sport event** that features athletes from all over India.
 
• The event is organized by the** Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** and is considered to be one of the biggest sporting events in the country. 
 
• The 36th National Games were held in Gujarat from** 29th Sep 2022 to 12th Oct 2022**.
 
• **New Delhi, and Kerala **have also hosted the National Games in the past. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andhra Pradesh:** The **32nd National Games** were held in Andhra Pradesh in **2002**.

 
 
• The event was held in the city of **Hyderabad**** **and featured **34 sports disciplines.**
 
 
 
• **New Delhi: **The **26th National Games** were held in New Delhi in **1985**.
 
• **Kerala**: The **27th and 35th** National Games were held in Kerala in **1987, and 2015 **respectively.
 
 
• Kerala is known for its** sports culture **and has produced many top athletes in various sports.
